blurb: Boom Island Brewing Company is a brewery located minutes from Lake Minnetonka with a family-friendly taproom. They offer a rotating selection of award-winning beers on tap and host live music events every Saturday night. The taproom can be reserved for private parties, happy hours, and other events.
